reuses_without_rewriting: m7-head-issue-v1 (ADR 0035 design philosophy, blinding pattern, isolated claude_cli backend, non-authority disposition contract)
m7-local-factorial-v3 (frozen execution condition, candidate schema, ADR 0037 extraction contract, failure-class taxonomy)
question: does ReviewGraphen with qwen3.8:27b-mlx surface findings on live, previously-unexamined fsl HEAD code that a cross-family judge would plausibly want tracked, and does the ReviewGraphen scaffold change this relative to unscaffolded qwen (B1)

target.ground_truth: none — this is undiscovered-defect search on live code, not known-target re-detection

units.algorithm_summary: global lexicographic file order under rust/*/src (excluding rust/spikes and tests/), greedy 120000-byte packet packing, 4 single-files-over-cap excluded and disclosed, 9-of-31 packets chosen by fixed-stride systematic sampling packet_index(i)=floor(i*31/9)

arms.measurement_target_distinction: STATED EXPLICITLY per QWEN_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md: qwen_full measures ReviewGraphen the IMPLEMENTATION (obligations synthesized by the running code, confirmed capability_gap-only for all real input, see CAPABILITY_GAP_DIAGNOSIS.md and docs/measurement-validity-obligation-synthesis-capability-gap.md). qwen_skill measures ReviewGraphen the METHODOLOGY (the model performs the obligation-enumeration-through-claim process itself, guided only by .claude/skills/reviewgraphen-methodology/SKILL.md, derived strictly from docs/03,06,07,08,09,10 and ADR 0011). These are never conflated in reporting; a qwen_skill result says nothing about the implementation, and vice versa.

qwen_b1.description: qwen3.8:27b-mlx given the unit's raw source files only, no ReviewGraphen scaffold
qwen_b1.role: baseline comparator; required so 'is ReviewGraphen useful' has an answer, not just 'does qwen find anything'
qwen_b1.status: n=1 (head-local-00 only), failed. No further trials planned; see DEVIATION_FULL_ARM_PRIORITY.md.

qwen_full.description: qwen3.8:27b-mlx given the unit's raw source files plus the ReviewGraphen implementation's synthesized scaffold (obligations, mechanism ontology, context envelopes)
qwen_full.scaffold_construction: reuses the existing full_reviewgraphen packet-construction path used for m7-local-factorial-v2/v3 (arm b1_free_form vs full_reviewgraphen), adapted to build fresh packets from the units in units.json instead of the frozen m7-real-v1 corpus
qwen_full.status: ZERO completed generation trials. The one attempt (head-local-00) was operator-terminated before completion (STOPPED_CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY.md) and is not restarted, because its obligations are already known by direct diagnosis to be capability_gap-only regardless of unit or duration. Its only evidence in this experiment is the packet-content diagnosis, not a generation result. Not a comparison point; see QWEN_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md.

qwen_skill.description: qwen3.8:27b-mlx given the unit's raw source files plus the frozen ReviewGraphen methodology skill (.claude/skills/reviewgraphen-methodology/SKILL.md body, verbatim, as the packet instruction text); the model enumerates its own obligations and forms claims per the skill's Stage 1-6 procedure
qwen_skill.obligation_cap: 8 self-enumerated obligations per unit maximum; experiment-side constraint (empirically justified in QWEN_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md), not derived from ReviewGraphen's design documents
qwen_skill.known_risk: reasoning-budget exhaustion is assessed, before execution, as plausibly MORE likely than for qwen_b1 (2/2 failures already observed in this program), because self-enumeration plus per-obligation claim/citation/evidence-status reasoning is strictly more generation work than the degenerate qwen_full packet ever required. This risk is not preempted by loosening any condition; a failure is recorded as reasoning_runaway and reported as a measured result.
qwen_skill.role: primary arm of interest going forward, per the operator's methodology-vs-implementation pivot

claude_skill.description: claude opus (effort: high) given the identical frozen skill scaffold as qwen_skill, on 3 of the 9 units (head-local-00/01/02 only), run via the isolated Claude CLI backend instead of the LM Studio/qwen path
claude_skill.skill_freeze: identical to qwen_skill: commit a092c32, body SHA-256 a43d6984f9b58d5e47256afed68cddc1598ae84d6fc564e05f1cf462228d670a — reuses qwen_skill's already-built packets byte-for-byte, hash-verified before this amendment, not rebuilt
claude_skill.scope: n=3 units only (head-local-00, head-local-01, head-local-02), narrower than qwen_skill's n=9; not generalized to the remaining 6 units by this amendment
claude_skill.generation_backend: reviewgraphen-benchmark run-process-reviewer-constrained claude, model=opus, effort=high, provider_constrained=true, --no-session-persistence and --tools "" (same isolation guarantee the judge backend already relies on)
claude_skill.generation_budget: separate $8 total cap for this arm's 3 generation calls, tracked independently from the existing $30 judge cap; --max-budget-usd 2.66 per call (8/3, worst-case total $7.98); see CLAUDE_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md Budget section for the per-call-vs-cumulative reasoning
claude_skill.known_risk: SAME-FAMILY, and in fact same specific model+effort, as the judge (both claude opus/high) — a strictly stronger correlated-error risk than qwen_skill's cross-family case (ADR 0035). No magnitude or direction is claimed. Not preempted by this amendment; blind judge protocol runs unchanged. Planned mitigation (not yet executed): GPT-family cross-validation pass after 2026-08-20.
claude_skill.pooling: joins qwen_skill in the SAME per-unit pool for the single primary blind judge pass over all 9 units, run after qwen_skill generation completes — explicitly distinct from, and does not alter, the already-completed qwen-only interim judge pass on these same 3 units (diagnostics/interim-judge-head-local-00-01-02/)
claude_skill.role: secondary arm; does not replace qwen_skill as primary, does not pause or interfere with the ongoing qwen_skill 9-unit generation

arms.extraction_contract: unchanged ADR 0037 (docs/adr/0037-candidate-json-extraction-contract.md): fenced-block-first, then left-to-right first JSON object, no repair or normalization
arms.candidate_schema: unchanged reviewgraphen.benchmark.candidate_output.v1 (same schema as m7-local-factorial-v2/v3, same schema across all three arms — no schema change was needed). obligation_results is expected empty for qwen_b1 (no obligations declared). For qwen_skill, obligation_results holds the model's own self-enumerated obligations: packet_id is a self-assigned identifier (e.g. obligation-1), disposition is the model's claim polarity (issue_present/issue_absent/inconclusive/not_applicable/abstained), and finding_local_ids links only issue_present obligations to findings — see SKILL.md 'Output mapping' and QWEN_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md.
arms.scoring: reviewgraphen-benchmark's 'validate candidate' (schema check) is reused unchanged; 'collect' (scoring against a private oracle) is NOT used anywhere in this experiment because there is no oracle — findings are counted and passed to the judge, never mechanically scored for detection

generation_execution_condition.backend: LM Studio behind cch, endpoint http://192.168.68.71:11999 only
generation_execution_condition.note_on_reasoning_effort: does not suppress reasoning on this backend (observed in m7-local-factorial-v3); retained anyway for continuity with the frozen v3 condition, not because it is expected to work
generation_execution_condition.sampling: provider default, unmodified — temperature/top_p never overridden
generation_execution_condition.max_output_tokens_amendment: raised from 65536 by OUTPUT_CAP_AMENDMENT.md after head-local-01 failed at exactly 65535/65536 output tokens; not pooled with the two qwen_skill results obtained under the old cap (see OUTPUT_CAP_STOP_AND_PROBE.md). Uses a forked profile/shaper (benchmarks/m7-head-local-v1/profile/lm-studio-cch-head-local-v1.config.toml, benchmarks/m7-head-local-v1/scripts/request_shaper.py) rather than editing m7-local-factorial-v3's own frozen, closed files.
generation_execution_condition.amendment_required_to_change: any change to this block after seeing any m7-head-local-v1 result requires a dated, committed amendment before the next call, per the discipline already applied throughout m7-local-factorial-v3

judge.backend: claude_cli via reviewgraphen-benchmark run-process-reviewer claude (generic isolated backend, distinct from the codex-profile adapter)
judge.blinding_mechanism: JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 2-4: content-hash finding_id excluding arm/generator/local_id, hash-sorted pooling across both arms per unit, --no-session-persistence, --tools "", forbidden-marker scan before packet construction
judge.authority: non-authoritative model disposition only, per ADR 0035; never itself creates an upstream object
judge.interim_analysis_guardrail: Recorded before any interim judge result exists, per operator instruction, to foreclose selective-stopping risk from looking at partial findings mid-generation: (1) the remaining units in the 9-unit qwen_skill generation run to completion regardless of what any interim analysis shows — an interim result is never a reason to stop or change generation; (2) any interim analysis (mechanical location verification or an exploratory judge pass on a subset of completed units) is explicitly exploratory and does not replace, and is reported as a separate, clearly-labeled record from, the primary result; (3) the primary result remains the single blind judge pass run under JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md over all 9 units after generation fully completes, unchanged by this guardrail; (4) any interim judge call's spend counts against the same $30 AUTH_AND_BUDGET_AMENDMENT.md cap as the final judge pass, and if cumulative spend approaches that cap, the final 9-unit judge pass is prioritized over completing or extending any interim analysis.
judge.codex_cross_validation: Prepared 2026-08-19 (CODEX_CROSS_VALIDATION_AMENDMENT.md), not yet executed; the operator's codex usage limit resets 2026-08-20 12:33 and execution happens after that, on explicit instruction. Re-runs the identical frozen JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md prompt and the identical 4-unit, 35-finding pool (head-local-00/01/02/04) that produced FINAL_JUDGE_REPORT.md, swapping only the judge backend to codex (model gpt-5.6-sol, effort high, chosen for parity with the Claude judge's opus/high). Purpose: test whether the primary Claude-judged result is robust to the same-family judge-bias risk CLAUDE_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md disclosed for the claude_skill arm. This pass never replaces, averages, or blends into the primary result -- it is a second, independent observation reported alongside the first. Disagreement-handling policy fixed before any result exists (full detail in the amendment): no selective adoption (every finding's both dispositions are reported, agreements and disagreements alike); the primary output is the agreement rate computed three ways (overall, per contributing arm -- the actual same-family-bias test, since claude_skill and qwen_skill can be compared separately -- and a full side-by-side listing of every disagreement); neither judge is treated as authoritative where they differ. No --max-budget-usd-equivalent exists for the Codex CLI (checked, not assumed), so this pass has no hard technical spend cap, unlike every other judge call in this experiment -- disclosed plainly in the amendment rather than implying a safeguard that does not exist.

execution.trial_order: ORIGINAL (superseded, see DEVIATION_FULL_ARM_PRIORITY.md): units in unit_index order 0..8, qwen_b1 before qwen_full within each unit. ACTUAL, as of the deviation recorded after observing head-local-00's qwen_b1 failure: qwen_b1 ran on head-local-00 only (1 trial); qwen_full then runs on all 9 units in unit_index order (head-local-00 through head-local-08). Strictly sequential throughout (one provider request in flight at a time), matching the concurrency=1 decision recorded in m7-local-factorial-v3 PARALLEL2_REVERT_AMENDMENT.md — unchanged by the deviation.
execution.total_generation_trials: ORIGINAL: 18 (9 x 2 arms). ACTUAL: 10 (1 qwen_b1 + 9 qwen_full), per DEVIATION_FULL_ARM_PRIORITY.md.
execution.judge_calls: ORIGINAL: at most 9 (one per unit), skipped for any unit whose pooled finding set is empty (JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 2.4). ACTUAL: 4 (head-local-00, 01, 02, 04) after a /tmp data loss destroyed head-local-03/05/06's sole surviving qwen_skill artifacts (artifact_lost, ARTIFACT_LOSS_AMENDMENT.md) on top of the pre-existing head-local-07 (empty_pool) and head-local-08 (upstream_blocked) exclusions. See ARTIFACT_LOSS_AMENDMENT.md for the recovery of head-local-00/01/02's qwen_skill findings from the interim judge pass and the resulting sampling bias.
execution.smoke_test_required: one synthetic-input smoke test of the claude_cli judge backend (JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 8) must complete and be recorded before the first real judge call; this backend has never been exercised end-to-end in this repository
execution.failure_taxonomy: As actually implemented in scripts/run_trial.sh (updated to reflect amendments made after the initial freeze from m7-local-factorial-v3 STAGE1_STATUS_SUMMARY.md, per the amendment-before-next-call discipline): valid, candidate_schema_invalid, transport_or_process_invalid, context_budget_exhausted_before_final, empty_final_after_process_completion, upstream_server_failure (upstream_status>=500), upstream_server_stream_incomplete (subtype upstream_model_crash), upstream_stream_closed_before_completion (added by RESTART_PROTOCOL_AND_UPSTREAM_HISTORY.md section 2 -- Codex's generic no-reason disconnect message, distinct from a crash), upstream_silent_truncation (added by RESTART_PROTOCOL_AND_UPSTREAM_HISTORY.md section 6 -- the server reports status=completed/error=null/incomplete_details=null but no message-type output item was ever produced, well short of max_output_tokens; the only class in this taxonomy that reports success while failing, see diagnostics/empty-final-content-investigation-head-local-04-08/REPORT.md), upstream_server_unresponsive, client_idle_timeout, operator_terminated, infrastructure. All upstream_* classes (upstream_server_failure, upstream_server_stream_incomplete, upstream_model_crash, upstream_stream_closed_before_completion, upstream_silent_truncation) are excluded from the semantic denominator and consume zero semantic attempts, per the two-strikes-then-upstream_blocked rule in RESTART_PROTOCOL_AND_UPSTREAM_HISTORY.md section 4. artifact_lost (added by ARTIFACT_LOSS_AMENDMENT.md) is a distinct, pool-construction-level exclusion, not a generation or judging outcome: applied to a unit whose generation trial already completed and was already recorded valid, where the artifact preserving that result was destroyed by an operational gap (a /tmp data loss after benchmark outputs were copied into the repo selectively rather than unconditionally after every trial) unrelated to the model, the generator, or any upstream server. Never conflated with an upstream_* class or with empty_final_after_process_completion.
stop_conditions: control endpoints respond but a generation or judge request never returns
operator redirect, recorded the same way m7-local-factorial-v3 cell 3 was recorded
execution.not_a_stop_condition: elapsed time alone; m7-local-factorial-v3 observed single trials completing successfully after more than 45 minutes and running past 85 minutes before failing, so duration alone is not evidence of a problem

completion_rate_tracking.unit_of_record: per (unit, arm) generation trial and per (unit) judge call
completion_rate_tracking.explicit_hypothesis_carried_from_v3: m7-local-factorial-v3 STAGE1_STATUS_SUMMARY.md section 4.4 observed one B1 trial exhaust its entire output budget on reasoning with zero final content (85.8 minutes) while the paired full_reviewgraphen trial on the same unit completed quickly (13.4 minutes, 23% of budget) and validated. This is an unconfirmed n=1 observation, not a claim. m7-head-local-v1 tracks per-arm completion rate explicitly so this can be checked with up to 9 more paired observations; a low qwen_b1 completion rate is itself a reportable result, not a nuisance to be explained away.

reported_metrics: generation completion rate per arm (fraction of 9 trials reaching valid schema-conformant output)
raw_findings_count per arm across all units (secondary metric only — inflated by within-arm and cross-arm near-duplicate repetition, see JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 7)
distinct_count per arm (clustered, JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 7): number of distinct underlying claims that arm raised, correcting for repetition
redundancy_ratio per arm = raw_findings_count / distinct_count (higher = more repetitive)
issue_should_be_created count and fraction per arm, both raw and clustered
should_not_be_created and unable_to_determine counts per arm
quality-rubric distribution per arm (specificity, unresolvable_location, reproduction_conditions_stated, false_positive_suspected, design_intent_confusion_suspected)
unresolvable_location_count and rate per arm (raw finding level; a hallucinated-location rate distinct from vagueness, see JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 7)

distinct_issue_worthy_count per arm (JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 7, cluster-level high_confidence_cluster credited to every contributing arm) — this is the PRIMARY count-based metric; the equivalent raw (unclustered) finding-level count is reported alongside it, never in place of it
cross-arm finding overlap (both the pre-clustering byte-identical collapse, JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 2.1, and the judge-asserted duplicate clusters that span both arms, section 7)
per-unit breakdown table (unit, arm, completion outcome, raw finding count, cluster membership, disposition tally)

usefulness_determination.status: REVISED TWICE. First by DEVIATION_FULL_ARM_PRIORITY.md (after observing two qwen_b1 failures, before any judge call). Second by QWEN_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md: qwen_full is confirmed to have zero completed generation trials and its obligations are, independent of that, confirmed capability_gap-only by direct diagnosis, so it cannot be the primary reported arm — qwen_skill (measuring the METHODOLOGY, not the implementation; see arms.measurement_target_distinction) is now primary. Both revisions were made before any judge call existed for this experiment. Still a descriptive synthesis, not a binary pass/fail gate.
usefulness_determination.primary_report: qwen_skill's absolute results, standing alone: distinct_issue_worthy_count (cluster-based, JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 7), total issue_should_be_created count and fraction (raw and distinct), raw_findings_count, generation completion rate (out of 9), and the full quality-rubric distribution. This is the primary answer to 'is the ReviewGraphen methodology useful when a local model executes it itself' and does not depend on any comparison to qwen_b1 or qwen_full.
usefulness_determination.b1_comparison_status: auxiliary and explicitly asymmetric (n=1 unit for qwen_b1 vs n=9 for qwen_skill). No superiority claim, no 'more evidence of usefulness than' framing, and no significance claim. qwen_b1's result is reported only as a narrow descriptive fact: whether raw unscaffolded qwen3.8:27b-mlx completed on the one unit attempted.
usefulness_determination.full_comparison_status: not applicable — qwen_full has zero completed generation trials (QWEN_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md). Its only role in this experiment's report is the capability_gap diagnosis itself, presented as a separate, already-answered question ('does the implementation currently produce substantive obligations' — no), not as a data point compared against qwen_skill's results.
usefulness_determination.why_distinct_not_raw: raw finding counts reward an arm for repeating the same underlying claim in different words rather than for finding more distinct problems; m7-real-v1 observed B1 producing roughly 6-8x more raw findings than full_reviewgraphen (115 vs 14-17) while judged-valid rates per finding were similar. distinct_issue_worthy_count is defined precisely to remove this bias; see JUDGE_PROTOCOL.md section 7. This reasoning governs how qwen_skill's own findings are de-duplicated against each other across its 9 units.
usefulness_determination.reported_regardless_of_the_rule_above: absolute issue_should_be_created counts and rates for qwen_skill (both raw and distinct) are always reported, since a near-zero count is itself informative — including a near-zero count caused by reasoning-budget exhaustion, which per QWEN_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md is itself a measured result about methodology weight versus local model capacity, not a nuisance to explain away. redundancy_ratio for qwen_skill is also always reported.
usefulness_determination.not_claimed: statistical significance, verified-defect counts, generalization beyond the 9 selected units, any qwen_b1-vs-qwen_skill superiority claim, or any claim about the ReviewGraphen implementation from qwen_skill results (see arms.measurement_target_distinction)

known_limitations: no ground truth: issue_should_be_created is a judge disposition, not a verified defect; recall cannot be estimated

single judge, single model family (Claude, opus, high effort); no calibration pass has been run because there is no known-defect calibration set for live-HEAD findings (unlike ADR 0035's matched-pair calibration, which m7-head-local-v1 does not attempt)

qwen (generator) and Claude (judge) are both LLMs; cross-family judging reduces but does not eliminate correlated error, and the judge's own competence at reading unfamiliar Rust/FSL code is itself unverified here

claude_skill's generator and the judge are the SAME model and effort tier (claude opus/high) — a strictly stronger same-provenance overlap than qwen_skill's cross-family case above; no magnitude or direction of resulting bias is claimed; see CLAUDE_SKILL_ARM_AMENDMENT.md 'Known risk' and the planned (not yet executed) post-2026-08-20 GPT-family cross-validation
n=9 units is an exploratory sample, not powered for any significance claim; see UNIT_SELECTION.md for coverage limits
4 files (including the single largest file in the workspace) are excluded from scope entirely by the oversize rule
the claude_cli judge backend has never been exercised end-to-end before this experiment (see execution.smoke_test_required)

generation completion rate is expected to be low based on m7-local-factorial-v3 (0/3 natural-conclusion requests reached final content under the identical execution condition before this experiment's redirect); m7-head-local-v1 may yield very few or zero judged findings per arm, and that is itself a reportable result about local-LLM operational feasibility, not a failure of this design

a post-generation /tmp data loss (ARTIFACT_LOSS_AMENDMENT.md) reduced the final judge pass from a possible 7 units to 4 (head-local-00/01/02/04); head-local-03/05/06's qwen_skill results are artifact_lost (5 findings, unrecoverable, not regenerated). The retained qwen_skill sample is systematically biased toward units where qwen_skill found more (the 3 lost units held the 3 lowest non-zero finding counts among the 8 measured units) -- qwen_skill's per-arm metrics in the final judge report should be read as describing its denser units, not its full original 8-unit spread. claude_skill's 3 units and their cross-arm comparison with qwen_skill on head-local-00/01/02 are unaffected by this loss.
